official_sources.title: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)

notes: Employers keeping a worker's passport is not allowed in the UAE. Confirm the current rule on the MOHRE site.
Private-sector salaries are generally paid through the Wage Protection System, which leaves a record of each payment.
The offer letter should be in a language you understand and should match the contract you sign later.

visa_routes.name: Employment visa and work permit
visa_routes.summary: The employer gets a work permit and entry permit. After arrival the worker completes a medical test and Emirates ID biometrics, then the residence visa is issued and the contract is registered.

steps.title: Signed offer letter
steps.description: Sign an offer letter that states salary, hours and benefits in a language you understand. Keep a copy.

steps.title: Work permit and entry permit
steps.description: The employer applies for your work permit and entry permit. The permit should be for employment, not a visit.

steps.title: Arrive and complete the medical test
steps.description: After arrival, complete the medical fitness test and Emirates ID biometrics.

steps.title: Residence visa and contract registration
steps.description: The residence visa is issued and the employment contract is registered. Compare it with your offer letter.

documents: Educational certificates, attested if the job needs them

requirements.title: Medical fitness test after arrival
requirements.description: Part of getting the residence visa.

requirements.title: Offer letter before the work permit
requirements.description: The offer letter you sign should match the contract registered later.
